findings.title: Hardcoded database password
findings.explanation: Storing sensitive information like database passwords in the source code can lead to security breaches if the code is exposed.
findings.suggestion: Use environment variables or a secure vault to manage sensitive information.

findings.title: SQL Injection vulnerability
findings.explanation: Using a Statement with user input directly in the SQL query allows for SQL injection attacks, compromising the database.
findings.suggestion: Use PreparedStatement for all SQL queries that include user input.

findings.title: Potential division by zero
findings.explanation: If the users list is empty, this will cause a division by zero error, leading to an exception.
findings.suggestion: Check if users.size() is greater than zero before performing the division.
